name: EchoNet
description: This outline as a node on a FidoNet-style network of outlines: copies of other outlines' echo areas, netmail both ways on marks, seen-by marks, a nodelist and a toss log. Store and forward, never a sync.

offline.description: Nodes (name@machine) to treat as unreachable this toss: a lid shut on purpose

outlines.description: The outlines folder whose .remote/ holds the machines' forwards (default: the host's)

keepLogs.description: How many toss logs stay under the nodelist (default 20)

actions.label: Toss mail
actions.description: Copies new messages from every subscribed area, marks copies whose original is newer, carries netmail both ways, writes the nodelist and a toss log

actions.label: Write the nodelist
actions.description: Writes the nodelist again without tossing: each known node, reachable or not, its access, areas and subscriptions
